summary: STIFTELSEN FOSSNES OG SOLBØ (org. no. 977 469 368) is a foundation (STI) based in Larvik, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-04-22. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 88.996 (Andre sosialtjenester uten botilbud ellers); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 59 510 and net income was NOK 15 354. Board chair: John Åge Amundsen; auditor: REVISJONSFIRMAET SCHUMACHER & HAMMER AS.
